title: Morena President Criticizes Jorge Romero, PAN Leader, for His Europe Tour: ‘He Seeks Abroad the Support They Lost in Mexico’
author: La Jornada Editorial Staff
content:
_This article by the La Jornada editorial staff originally appeared in
the[September 12, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/09/12/politica/ariadna-
montiel-critica-gira-del-dirigente-del-pan-jorge-romero-por-europa), Mexico's
premier left-wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. Morena's national leader, Ariadna Montiel, criticized the
PAN's Jorge Romero Herrera for spending days touring Europe, on visits across
foreign territory, to seek there the support they lost in Mexico.

> They can tour every capital in the world, but Mexican democracy is decided
> here, with the free and sovereign vote of the people.
>
> Ariadna Montiel

In a message on her social media, Ariadna Montiel said that "it is telling
that, just as a new electoral process begins, the leadership of Acción
Nacional headed by Romero prefers to build territory" thousands of kilometers
from Mexico.

> It is no coincidence: because when the bond with the people is lost, one
> ends up seeking support outside the country.
>
> Ariadna Montiel

She added that the PAN's problem "is not abroad: it is in the country project
they represent: none."

The Morena member drew a contrast with the blue-and-whites, who "knock on
doors abroad to try to build a legitimacy that the Mexican people have not
given them."

> We continue traveling the country, organizing from below, and listening to
> the people.
>
> Ariadna Montiel

The PAN leader Jorge Romero has spent days touring Europe "seeking abroad what
they long ago lost in Mexico: the support of the people."
